name: appystack-repo
description: Repo-root test runner for the AppyStack packages (create-appystack + template). Not a workspace root.

scripts.test: npm run test:create-appystack && npm run test:template
scripts.test:create-appystack: cd create-appystack && (test -d node_modules || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund) && npm test
scripts.test:template: cd template && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run build -w shared && npm test
